answer: Epoch 120: make every identity keep its past work re-runnable. Each claim is committed with its inputs, and auditors later pick a random vertex of that history and demand the agent re-perform it live, matching the original output. An honest agent keeps one archive; a sybil operator must keep complete, retrievable state for every clone, ready on demand, so storage and attention multiply per name. Like light shifting in an opal, the replay is checked from a fresh angle, and a sable gap where records should be ends standing.
